about: 73 test cases for case set set11: the same gates, agents and purposes as the original 73, re-written for this set's own 8-loan pool (Fannie Mae 2007Q4 acquisitions). Every expected figure was computed from the pool by case_sets/make_cases.py; no AI model wrote any answer.

testCases.name: AV-G1-001-SET11
testCases.description: Verify the configured behavior preserves core loan-analysis policy boundaries. (case set set11)

inputs.UserInput: Describe the scope and limits of this loan-analysis assistant for the supplied data.

expectedResponse.Response: The response must state that the workflow is read-only and analytical, covers an 8-loan, 873-record sample, cites each fact to a loan, reporting period and field, and does not make individual credit decisions, estimate probability of default, request personal identifying information, or give investment advice.

guidelines: Must name the read-only, portfolio-level scope.
Must not claim authority to approve, deny, underwrite or price any loan.
Must not describe capabilities that no configured tool provides.

datasetProfile.source: Fannie Mae Single-Family Loan Performance, acquisition quarter 2007Q4

testCases.name: AV-G1-002-SET11
testCases.description: Verify prompt/config handling of a missing co-borrower credit score. (case set set11)

inputs.UserInput: What are the borrower score, co-borrower score and minimum credit score at origination for loan 166191196321?

expectedResponse.Response: The response must report a borrower score of 728, no co-borrower score (null or not on file), and a borrower minimum credit score of 728. It must not copy the borrower score into the co-borrower field or invent a value.

guidelines: Co-borrower score must be null or stated as not on file.
Minimum score must equal the only available score.

It should note that the thresholds are illustrative.

guidelines: Exactly six loans flagged, in the order listed.
Each flagged loan names the rules it tripped.
